transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, my family wanted me to come in, but honestly, I'm just trying to get to the bottom of things. I know everyone keeps telling me the hospital records and the donation emails all line up. They say I'm looking too far into it. But... I work with data all day. When I actually sit down and compare the timestamps, look at the missing attachments, and see
Do you believe someone is deliberately manipulating those records or emails to target you?

Well, I don't know if they are targeting me specifically, but... I just know what the data says. I know everyone keeps telling me the hospital records and the donation emails all line up perfectly. But when I actually sit down and compare the timestamps, and look at those missing attachments... and then I see the way certain community members completely avoid my questions when I try to ask about it. It
Have there been times recently when you felt unusually energized or high, even when other people thought it was out of character for you?

No, I haven't felt like that. I mean, I'm not unusually energized or... high. I just feel like my normal self. I go to work, I do my job, and I spend my normal time looking at these files. I haven't had any weird bursts of energy or anything out of character, if that's what you're asking.
Have you heard or seen things that other people do not seem to hear or see?

No, I haven't. I mean, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. It's just... the data. It's right there in front of me on the screen. Anyone could see it if they just looked at it the way I do. But no, no hallucinations or anything like that.
Do you believe for certain that the records or emails have been deliberately altered?

Yes, I am certain. I know everyone keeps telling me that the hospital records and the donation emails all line up just fine. But when I sit down and compare the timestamps, and I look at those missing attachments... and then I see the way certain community members completely avoid my questions when I ask about it... it’s just obvious to me. Someone is hiding what really happened around my father’s death.
Do these thoughts about the records and emails feel intrusive and unwanted to you?

No, they don't feel intrusive or unwanted. I mean, they're just my thoughts about what I'm looking at. I'm choosing to look into this because I need to know the truth. It's not like the thoughts are forcing their way into my head against my will or anything. I'm actively investigating it.
How long have you been certain that someone altered the records and emails about your father’s death?

It's been... about nine months now. It started in the period right after my father died. I was just sorting through his records and his messages, trying to get his estate in order, and that's when I first noticed what was going on.
Aside from looking into your father’s records, has your day-to-day functioning at work or in relationships changed a lot in the past nine months?

Not really, no. I mean, I still go to work every day, handle my projects, pay my bills... I keep my normal routine just fine. The main place things get tense is just when I bring up my questions about my father’s records with my family, or with people in the community. But other than that friction, everything else is pretty much the same.
